compiled_state.title: Write RED test for post-migration duration capture script output schema
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: Post-migration p50 and p95 CI review-job duration on the fixture corpus is measured and paired with S1's pre-migration baseline. The delta is recorded in a checked-in artifact and surfaced for S7's close-artifact report.

## TDD Requirement
Write a failing test that asserts:
1. tests/fixtures/ci-review-post-migration.json exists (this file does not yet exist — RED)
2. The artifact has the required schema fields: captured_at, iterations, p50_ms, p95_ms, min_ms, max_ms, python_version, mode, pre_migration_p50_ms, pre_migration_p95_ms, p50_delta_ms, p95_delta_ms
3. p50_ms and p95_ms are numeric
4. mode is "post_migration_dry_run"
5. p50_delta_ms and p95_delta_ms are computed as (post - pre) and are present

Given: tests/fixtures/ci-review-post-migration.json
When: the file is loaded as JSON
Then: all required schema fields are present and valid types

Test file: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py
Test function: test_post_migration_artifact_schema

Also write a second test asserting the artifact is not stale (captured_at within 30 days of the repo's last commit — or simply assert the file exists and is valid JSON without a staleness gate, since staleness would create a flaky CI test).

RED marker: add to .test-index:
  tests/fixtures/ci-review-post-migration.json: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py [test_post_migration_artifact_schema]

Note: test_post_migration_artifact_schema will FAIL (RED) until T4 creates the artifact.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — note: this test will be excluded via RED marker in run-python-tests.sh
  Verify: bash tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py
- [ ] tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py exists
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py
- [ ] .test-index contains RED marker for the test
  Verify: grep -q "test_post_migration_artifact_schema" .test-index
- [ ] The test FAILS (RED) at this point — artifact not yet created
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_post_migration_metrics.py::test_post_migration_artifact_schema -v 2>&1 | grep -q "FAILED\|ERROR"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
